# Cueful

> Cueful is a web-based creator profile builder for focused links, referral offers, coupon codes, and audience analytics.

## Product

- Homepage: https://cueful.bio/
- Templates: https://cueful.bio/templates
- Live demo: https://cueful.bio/demo
- Public profiles use the format: https://cueful.bio/u/username

## Core capabilities

- Build a responsive public creator profile.
- Organize standard links and featured links.
- Present referral offers with benefits and coupon codes.
- Track link opens, referral opens, and coupon-code copies.
- Choose from creator, freelancer, and referral-curator templates.

## Example profiles

- Creator: https://cueful.bio/u/maya-makes
- Freelancer: https://cueful.bio/u/sam-builds
- Referral curator: https://cueful.bio/u/dani-deals

## Access

Cueful is free to start. Account creation and profile management are available from the homepage.
